metadata.summary: Show a clearer enrollment-hold explanation before registration submission.
metadata.requested_behavior: A student with an active hold sees the hold category and support route before attempting registration.
metadata.release_trigger: Scheduled release window after acceptance evidence and support materials are reviewed.

user_facing_behavior.before: The synthetic workflow displays a generic registration-blocked message.
user_facing_behavior.after: The synthetic workflow displays the hold category, non-sensitive next step, and support route.
user_facing_behavior.communications: Synthetic release note and support decision tree describe the wording change and escalation path.

known_limitations.description: The example does not expose detailed hold records; it displays only a category label.
known_limitations.mitigation: Direct users to the owning office for record-specific questions.
known_limitations.follow_up_trigger: Revisit if support logs show category wording is insufficient.

requirements.statement: Display an actionable hold explanation before registration submission.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Supported synthetic hold categories render the expected non-sensitive category and support route.

requirements.statement: Preserve the existing registration-block behavior while changing explanatory text.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Blocked synthetic cases remain blocked and unblocked cases remain unaffected.

acceptance_evidence.notes: Fictional example covering configured synthetic hold categories.
Fictional UAT record used only to demonstrate traceability.
Fictional regression evidence; not a University test result.

support_readiness.item: Support decision tree includes the new hold-category wording and escalation route.
Known-error guidance states that explanatory wording changes do not alter the block decision.

operational_needs.need: Observe support-contact volume tagged to registration holds after the change.
Keep the existing registration-block recovery procedure available to on-call support.

rollback_and_recovery.rollback_trigger: Unexpected change to block decisions or materially misleading hold text in the synthetic scenario.
rollback_and_recovery.rollback_method: Restore the prior presentation bundle while preserving the unchanged synthetic block decision service.
rollback_and_recovery.data_recovery_notes: No synthetic data migration is part of this example.
